current_problem.risk: 若 scorer 與人格契約語意不一致，後續模型或 carrier 比較沒有可信的尺。

falsifiable_hypothesis: 若 required、optional、forbidden 與 ordered pairs 由同一份 typed evaluation contract 驅動，則 scorer 應在不呼叫模型的凍結校準集中正確接受同義改寫與 optional omission，並正確拒絕缺漏、禁止內容、順序反轉與超長輸出。
single_changed_variable: replace the V3 ad hoc persona marker and literal ordering logic with one evaluation-only typed scorer contract; runtime, model, prompts, V3 results, memory, actions, and source observations remain unchanged
controls: all probes are synthetic scorer calibration text and are never sent to a model
each context has three expected-pass and three expected-fail probes
optional omission, synonym substitution, missing required content, forbidden content, order reversal, and length are represented
the scorer contract is evaluation-only and cannot enter runtime payload, memory, training, or Function Calling
V3 raw results and sealed V2 holdout remain unchanged
evidence_boundary: A pass proves only internal semantic consistency of the deterministic scorer on synthetic calibration probes. It does not prove that the behavioral contract is a complete description of the target public persona, that model outputs improved, or that unseen human judgments will agree.
